title: Divisible Arm Lengths, Crystal Reflections, and Enumeration of Newly Found Decomposition Columns
summary: In recent work the authors determine complete columns of symmetric-group decomposition matrices in odd prime characteristic $p$ labeled by $p$-regular partitions for which every hook of length divisible by $p$ has even arm length. In the present paper we enumerate these partitions and prove that each block of $p$-weight $w$ contains precisely \[ \binom{w+\frac{p-3}{2}}{w} \] such partitions. More generally, for any integers $d,e>1$, we study and enumerate $d$-balanced $e$-regular partitions -- partitions for which every hook of length divisible by $e$ has arm length divisible by $d$.
